title: Trillanes links Sara Duterte to China | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Sonny Trillanes, Sara Duterte, Asian Games

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Mans Carpio’s firm got P319 million from ‘Chinese government and corporations’ — Trillanes

blocks.text: Former senator Sonny Trillanes alleges entities tied to Vice President Sara Duterte received hundreds of millions of pesos in funds from the ‘Chinese government and corporations.’

items: Verdict on Sara Duterte may be out December 16 — Senate court spokesman

blocks.text: Senate impeachment court spokesperson Reginald Tongol says a verdict may be issued in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial as early as December 16.

items: Cesar Virata, Marcos-era prime minister and finance chief, dies at 95

blocks.text: Former Philippine prime minister and longtime finance chief Cesar Virata dies on Friday, October 2. He was 95.

items: Jeus Yape claims PH’s 4th gold in Asian Games with virtual taekwondo triumph

blocks.text: Jeus Gabriel Derick Yape brings home the Philippines’ fourth gold medal in the 2026 Asian Games in Japan after ruling the mixed individual virtual taekwondo. – Rappler.com
